rv.q: This thoroughbred production deserves to find a whole new generation of smitten theatregoers.
The show remains a heart-tugging, visually inventive spectacle.
Opening just before Armistice Day, this version of the show retains all of its emotional force and its intoxicating theatrical flair.

cn.t: War Horse returns as a visually inventive, heart-tugging spectacle with tour-de-force moments like the horrific cavalry charge that showcase its theatrical power.
